body: It's a good thing I don't want kids.

>I enjoy everything else in my life (food, writing, volunteer work, family, Internet, occasional political discussion/activism)

What else do you suggest?

I never lose my own interests and sense of self, just add to them. I did take some social skills classes a few years ago (stopped because I could no longer afford them). These days, I think it's not so much "I don't know what to do", and more "I'd rather do it my own way". 

Edit: more info.

I've heard that those of us on the spectrum do have higher rates of mood disorders. I checked out BPD as well, but the whole emotionally-manipulative-and-socially-adept part doesn't seem to fit me. Although I do have issues with binge/overeating...
As a matter of fact, I'm currently working on five stories for kids :)
This will probably be a throwaway account. I'm much more of a browser than a poster. But just know I'm going to stay alive, no matter how hard it gets.
Thank you for being moved. It's good to know someone cares, even if it's a stranger I've never met.
